description: Durable gated progress acceptance scenarios. Consumers construct real repositories/scanners and assert finite discovery, bounded RPCs, and no absence from resumed coverage. Times are seconds; every history page advances by its physical row count and ends only at empty or all expected found.

vectors.name: newer paid attempt behind unresolved cohort
wallet caps requested twenty to ten
stale lease cannot overwrite new checkpoint
two failing historical cohorts cannot starve a newer payment
sweep straddling expiry grace requires fresh coverage
continuous arrivals cannot postpone a failed fulfillment retry
page cut by the scan deadline keeps the walk's progress
vectors.rule: Each pass the wallet answers pages_before_deadline pages; the next page is still in flight when the slice deadline passes, and the client fails it. A slice cut after at least one answered page ends continued with the progress of its completed pages, so the walk reaches paid_index within max_passes instead of restarting at offset 0 every pass. A slice whose first page is cut made no progress and still fails the pass (scan_failed, with its warning), so a wallet that never answers stays visible.

vectors.name: host-clock attempt cannot widen a wallet-timed cohort
vectors.rule: A legacy host-clock attempt (created_at_source missing or host) and a paid wallet-timed attempt are pending together. The wallet-timed attempt gets its own bounded window [wallet_created_at - overlap, wallet_created_at + overlap], scanned first, and settles in the first pass; the host-clock attempt keeps its full-history window (from 0, no until) and is walked on the next pass.

vectors.name: mixed batches cannot skip a host-timed attempt
vectors.rule: pending_count attempts alternate in keyset order: even indexes wallet-timed, odd indexes host-timed, created one second apart from created_at_start, all unexpired. That is more than one batch, so a selection often has one free window slot. Selection advances the cursor only past candidates already queued or admitted to a new window. A candidate whose clock source has no free slot is read again by the next selection, never skipped. The wallet honors from, until, unpaid and offset, and pages page_size rows. Only paid_index is settled (at settled_at). It settles within max_passes, one pass every pass_seconds, and fulfills once; every other attempt stays pending.

vectors.name: one answered page per slice still advances the walk
vectors.rule: As the deadline-cut vector, but the wallet answers only one page per pass. A resumed slice spends that page re-reading its overlap page. When a slice answers only the overlap and the next page is cut, the overlap is spent: the next slice reads the unseen page first instead of the same overlap again. The walk reaches paid_index within max_passes, for a wallet-timed and a host-timed attempt alike, and fulfills once.
